name: Assembleur de débitmètres
description: Very muscular adult, dense russet spotted hide, wide head with low squared crest, pronounced asymmetrical mandible tusks, thick black dreadlocks hanging to mid-back. Sleeveless reinforced cream work tunic, cropped leather apron split into two panels, single bronze shoulder guard, heavy belt. Holding a disassembled round bronze flow meter across both hands with an exposed miniature turbine component, several tool pockets and sealed small water flask. Relaxed square stance.
